log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., debug, info, warn, error)

refresh_interval.description: Number of minutes between automatic trust anchor list refreshes

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent validation sessions

strict_mode.description: If true, strict validation rejects invalid or malformed data; if false, warnings are logged but processing continues

max_chain_depth.description: Maximum allowed depth for certificate chains during validation

tal_files.description: List of file paths (or glob patterns) to Trust Anchor Locator (TAL) files

repositories.description: List of default RPKI repositories to include by default (by TAL URI + name)

trust_anchors.description: Optional explicit trust anchor certificates to use instead of TAL-derived ones

name.description: Descriptive name for the trust anchor

cert_file.description: Path to the trust anchor certificate file (PEM format)

ca_repos.description: Optional custom CA repository endpoints (e.g., for testing or private RPKI deployments)

cache_dir.description: Path to a persistent local cache directory for repository data; defaults to system temp if omitted

http2_enabled.description: Enable HTTP/2 protocol support for repository downloads

timeouts.description: Connection and I/O timeout settings in seconds

connect.description: Timeout to establish connection to repository (seconds)

rate_limits.description: Per-repository rate limits to avoid throttling; each entry specifies a repository URI and max requests per minute

uri.description: Repository URI to apply the limit to

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum requests per minute to that repository
